title: Way to make all items hidden, not visible
line: The System Tray settings have a "Set All To" menu that changes every entry's visibility at once, for example to show them all only in the popup.
explanation: The Entries list in the System Tray settings only had "Always show all" as a bulk option, so hiding everything from the panel meant changing each entry's combobox to "Show only in popup" one by one. The page now has a "Set All To" menu next to that checkbox with Show when relevant, Always show and Show only in popup; it queues the change for every entry like the per-entry comboboxes do (applied with Apply/OK) and leaves disabled entries disabled. The per-entry original-visibility logic moved into a page function so the menu and the delegates share it.

commits.message:
applets/systemtray: add a menu to set the visibility of all entries

Making the tray small meant changing every entry to "Show only in popup"
one by one, as only "Always show all" works on all of them. A "Set All
To" menu now changes every entry at once, leaving disabled ones alone.

BUG: 448007
